# C# generated by Runic Translations 0.8.0

These files are the output of the 0.8.0 generator for the catalog in
`GeneratedCSharpSnapshotTests` (`v0.8.0:tests/fixtures/translations/generated-csharp`). They are frozen: never
regenerate them. `Runic.Translations.Runtime.Tests` compiles them against the current runtime and runs them
(`PreviousGeneratorTests`), which checks the version rule that code generated by release N runs on runtime N or
later within the same major. Add the output of a later release beside this directory when its generated code changes.
